daily-morning-paper-v1.label: Daily morning paper photo
daily-morning-paper-v1.prompt: Realistic editorial photo of a folded daily morning newspaper resting on a wooden desk, natural reading creases, ambient morning light. The newspaper is open to the feature section with rich editorial layout: headline type, body copy columns, pull quotes, and inset photos. Use the following article brief as source material, not literal text to render: [题图提示词][当天日期]. Visible newspaper words should be concise Chinese headlines, labels, and short pull quotes derived from the article brief. Do not render production instructions, layout metadata, or prompt wording as newspaper text.

Use the following article brief as source material, not literal text to render: [题图提示词].
